notes.title: RAEV is Heading to Gamescom 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Salutations Future Raevin Royalty,[/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563470/RAEV_Kingdom_on_the_Distant_Shores/"]RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores[/url][/u][/i][/b] will debut its first playable demo at Gamescom 2025! If you’re at the show, come visit the [b]Ravine Games booth, located at hall 10-1, booth B060[/b] from August 20th - 24th! 

We're bringing a fresh slice of the kingdom straight to Cologne. This demo gives you a first hands-on taste of ruling; from cozy little villages to bustling cities, you'll be in charge of it all. Shape your lands, lead your people, and dive into real-time battles to defend what’s yours.

There’s a lot to explore in the Gamescom Demo:[/p][list][*][p]60+ unique building types[/p][/*][*][p]20+ unit types[/p][/*][*][p]3 Distinct Biomes[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition to the exciting Gamescom news, we also have some new screenshots. Get a sneak peek into the Kingdom and adventure ahead.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/980fbd2d69b3c93d50fae814428e21c45ac3d0f5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/d7e3c16397324f2da7088490befab46b1b8fd2b1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/717a889d7f509ff61919228851ee0ba987dad1fb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/166c249452837a27fba4d5070d842c0a060fe89a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/fab12c1420d552c6d2c3d73c978b73961801edc5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546096/e9011949b47dc88b762e3594018d9d88b2fc6d19.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Whether you’re joining us in person or following along from afar, we can’t wait to share this next chapter of [b][i]RAEV[/i][/b] with you.[/p][p]See you soon! 
 — The Ravine Games Team[/p]
